Introduction

DAYCHILD is a six-member boy group under Black Bear Records, known for their vibrant energy and fresh musical style. The group's name holds a special meaning: ‘Day’ represents a bright and new beginning, while ‘Child’ symbolizes innocence and newness. Together, DAYCHILD embodies the concept of "a group as pure and bright as a new day."

The group officially debuted on May 6, 2024, with the release of their first single album, "Illumination". Prior to their debut, DAYCHILD launched a crowdfunding campaign for the album on January 19, 2024, via the Rising Star platform. However, during the campaign, it was announced on February 19 that original member Roy had departed due to personal reasons. In response, the agency canceled the crowdfunding project to undergo internal restructuring.

On March 13, Intae was introduced as a new member, finalizing the revised lineup. A renewed crowdfunding campaign began on March 15 and concluded on April 14, with the official debut date confirmed shortly after on April 22. Later that year, on October 28, 2024, DAYCHILD announced their first comeback with their second single album, "Crescent", released on November 14.

The group continued to expand in 2025, making their Japanese debut with the single "Kimi to Naraba", released on February 9, following the promotional schedule dropped on February 4. As part of their continued evolution, DAYCHILD introduced two new members, Sunghoon and Yejong, through updated profile photos released on April 14, 2025.

DAYCHILD's bond with their fans was solidified on December 16, 2024, when they officially announced their fandom name: "DAYON". Accompanied by the heartfelt message, “We look forward to the days we will illuminate together,” the name reflects the group’s commitment to growing alongside their fans, radiating brightness and sincerity every step of the way.
